name: FormDialog
intent: Single-step create or edit modal carrying the house authoring contract: a submit that is never disabled, per-field errors that appear only after a refused submit, and a reset that runs on close as well as on success.
when: Creating a new record from a handful of fields that fit one screen
Editing a record's metadata in a modal rather than on a detail page
Any authoring form that needs the house required-field behaviour without re-deriving it
whenNot: The form needs more than one screen -> use WizardDialog
Confirming or acknowledging an action with no fields -> use ConfirmDialog or AlertDialog
A page-level form that is not modal -> use Form with FormActionBar

chooseOver.because: FormDialog owns the attempted flag, the never-disable rule, the hint/error footer swap, and reset-on-close — the four decisions every hand-assembled copy had to remember and several got subtly different.

onOpenChange.note: Fired on dismiss, on Escape, and after a successful submit.

valid.note: Whether a submit may succeed. The button stays enabled either way.

onReset.note: Clears the caller's field state. Runs on close AND after a successful submit.

hint.note: Footer guidance shown until a submit is refused.

error.note: Replaces `hint` once a submit has been refused.

width.note: Max width in px. Defaults to 520.

keepOpenOnSubmit.note: Empty the form and stay up, for adding several records in a row.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Not a collection widget; the caller owns all field state and identity.

states.default: Fields at their initial values, footer showing `hint`, nothing painted invalid.
states.refused: A submit while `valid` is false: position holds, the footer swaps to `error`, and every field marked `invalid` paints.
states.reopened: `onReset` having run on close, the next open starts empty rather than holding the last attempt.

allowedPlacement: anywhere a create or edit action is triggered
evaluationCriteria: The submit button is never rendered disabled.
No field shows an error before a submit has been refused.
Re-opening after a dismiss shows empty fields.
The footer states what is missing, not merely that something is.

lineage.authoredBy: Extracted from the eleven hand-copied create/edit dialogs found in the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-25)

extracted: per-field invalid painting gated on attempted
reset on close as well as on success

lineage.supersedes: NewProcessDialog, NewPipelineDialog and nine sibling template-local form dialogs
notes: The invalid/showError split is deliberate: call sites pass validity, the widget owns timing.

usage: Use FormDialog when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
FormDialog should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional sub-heading under the title band.

props.name: width
props.description: Max width of the dialog in pixels. Defaults to `520` — the width of the narrowest shipped authoring dialog; widen only when a field row genuinely needs two columns.

props.name: valid
props.description: Whether the form may be submitted. The submit button stays enabled either way — this only decides whether a press succeeds or reveals the errors.

props.name: hint
props.description: Footer guidance shown until a submit is refused, e.g. "Name it, then create."

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces `hint` once a submit has been refused. Say what is missing, not that something is.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Label of the confirming button, e.g. "Create process".

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label of the dismissing button. Defaults to "Cancel".

props.name: submitVariant
props.description: Variant of the confirming button. Defaults to the primary `default`.

props.name: submitProps
props.description: Extra props for the confirming button — test hooks, `data- ` attributes.

props.name: keepOpenOnSubmit
props.description: Keep the dialog open after a successful submit — for a form that stays up to add another.

anatomy.description: FormDialog is composed of the following parts:

parts.name: FormDialogField
parts.description: The field element of the FormDialog.

parts.name: FormDialogRow
parts.description: The row element of the FormDialog.

parts.name: FormDialogNote
parts.description: The note element of the FormDialog.

parts.name: FormDialogCaveat
parts.description: The caveat element of the FormDialog.

bestPractices.title: Focus management
bestPractices.description: Trap focus within the dialog and return focus when closed.

bestPractices.title: Don't nest dialogs
bestPractices.description: Avoid opening dialogs from within dialogs, use sequential flow instead.

bestPractices.title: Provide clear exit
bestPractices.description: Always include a visible close button and support Escape key.

bestPractices.title: Don't trap users
bestPractices.description: Never make dialogs impossible to close or require specific actions to dismiss.
bestPractices.example: // No close button or escape handling

bestPractices.title: Keep content focused
bestPractices.description: Limit dialog content to a single task or decision.

bestPractices.title: Don't overload dialogs
bestPractices.description: Avoid putting complex forms or multiple tasks in a single dialog.
